name: letsaskit
description: LetsAskIt — creation-first AI content engine: one brief in, finished content for every platform (LinkedIn post, X thread, newsletter section, SEO article, summary) in your brand voice, every piece with a visible quality gate. Served by the hosted LetsAskIt MCP server.

settings.name: LetsAskIt API Key
settings.description: Your LetsAskIt Team-tier API key (MCP access is a Team-plan feature; the free Studio tier is web-only at letsaskit.com/studio). The extension sends it as the Authorization header to the LetsAskIt MCP server.
